# Crew

> A playable control room for a real CrewAI agent company. Give a company a goal; its agents plan, hire, use sandboxed tools, produce verified files and ask for approvals. Watch it all in an animated office. Local-first, experimental, one trusted workspace.

## Quick start

Requires Docker with Compose. No provider key is needed to evaluate: Demo uses deterministic simulated agents and spends nothing.

```sh
docker compose up --build
```

- UI: `http://localhost:5173`, API: `http://127.0.0.1:8787` (both bind to loopback only).
- Live mode: connect a provider key from the UI (`Configure provider`), then explicitly enable Live.

## Facts

- Execution engine: [CrewAI](https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI). Orchestration, budgets, verification and the audit trail are Crew's own; the office is a view of the same event records.
- Providers: DeepSeek (shipped default), OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, local Ollama.
- Runtime: Python 3.13 backend, React 19 / Node 26 frontend, Docker for agent command execution (no host fallback), SQLite for state and an encrypted local vault for keys.
- Safeguards: a capability policy engine plus human approvals gate privileged actions; verification precedes reward; the audit log is hash-chained; a successful verifier result is not a human review.
- License: MIT. Status: experimental; one server process and one shared workspace per installation.
